description: Test suite for command-related CLI functions in Mattermost, including listing, archiving, modifying, and showing commands, with permission and error handling.

classes.name: MmctlE2ETestSuite
classes.description: Test suite struct for end-to-end testing of command CLI functions.

methods.name: TestListCommandCmd
methods.description: Tests for listing commands, including non-existent, specific team, all teams, and permission scenarios.

methods.name: TestArchiveCommandCmdF
methods.description: Tests for archiving commands, including non-existent, successful archive, and permission denial.

methods.name: TestModifyCommandCmdF
methods.description: Tests for modifying commands, including success, non-existent command, and invalid trigger word.

methods.name: TestShowCommandCmdF
methods.description: Tests for showing commands, including non-existent, by command ID, and by team:trigger.
